units.locator: Article 114. Procedure for the entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 1. This Federal Law shall enter into force on 1 January 2014, except for provisions for which this Article specifies other commencement dates.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 114

units.locator: Article 114. Procedure for the entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 1.1. Article 45, paragraph 6, point 1, and paragraphs 8 and 11, of this Federal Law shall enter into force on 31 March 2014.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 114

units.locator: Article 114. Procedure for the entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 1.2. Article 34(26) and Article 35 of this Federal Law shall enter into force on 1 July 2014.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 114

units.locator: Article 114. Procedure for the entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 2. Article 4(3)(16); Articles 16, 17, 18 and 19; Article 21(1)–(10) and (12)–(15); Article 23(1) and (2); Article 25(2)(1.1); Article 26(5); and Article 38(4), points 1 and 2, of this Federal Law shall enter into force on 1 January 2016.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 114

units.locator: Article 114. Procedure for the entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 3. Article 4, paragraph 1, point 2, and paragraph 3, points 1–3; Article 20; Article 21(11); Article 23(4); Article 42(3); Article 97(1); Article 99, paragraph 5 and paragraph 8, point 1; Article 103(2)(12); and Article 104(3)(5) of this Federal Law shall enter into force on 1 January 2017.
